snippet.title: False Hero - Official Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
False Hero is a fast-paced indie soulslike adventure where you steal your enemies’ attacks and chain them into deadly combos. Explore the corrupted Lands of the Gods and put your combat skills to the true test in challenging boss fights. Will you fight for the Gods or become an apostle of Death?

Try the Demo now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4702340/False_Hero_Demo/
